test_Cartesian4dVelocityEffector_zero_xy: test Cartesian4dVelocityEffector that zero XY rotation is applied when the robot arm points straight down
test_Cartesian4dVelocityEffector_nonzero: test Cartesian4dVelocityEffector that nonzero XY rotation is applied when the robot arm is not pointing straight down
test_limit_to_workspace: test limit_to_workspace function that restricts effector commands within defined min and max workspace bounds
test_limit_to_workspace_wrist_rotation: test limit_to_workspace function with wrist joint limits to constrain wrist rotation range on a Sawyer arm
test_Cartesian4dVelocityEffector_control: test Cartesian4dVelocityEffector with a custom control frame to verify correct coordinate transformation of velocity commands
